entities.summary: Claudia Casabianca is a retired professional tennis player from Argentina who played in Grand Slam tournaments in the 1970s and 1980s. At age 17, Casabianca won the girls' singles title at the 1977 US Open, becoming the first female Argentine player to win a tennis championship abroad.
